title: ChatToolCall
description: Canonical chat tool-call payload presented to the user for confirmation and bound by HMAC (RD P1.9) for execution in Phase 7. Phase 0 wave 3 — issue #110. The HMAC over this payload ensures the executed payload cannot be substituted for the confirmed one.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Consumers MUST reject unknown versions (Kirk #6).

tool_name.description: Registered tool name to invoke (e.g. `run_redeem`, `run_discord_monitor`, `run_refresh_token`). Validated against the tool registry at execution time.

args.description: Canonical (sorted-keys) tool arguments object. Hashed into idempotency_key.

actor.description: GitHub username (allowlisted operator) who initiated the chat tool call.

session_id.description: Chat session identifier this confirmation belongs to.

request_id.description: Per-request UUID v4 for log correlation.

reason.description: Free-form user-supplied reason captured in the confirm modal; surfaced in audit + run-result.

idempotency_key.description: HMAC of actor + tool_name + canonical-args + 5-minute window. Deterministic dedup key (RD P0.3).

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the confirmation token was issued.

ttl_seconds.description: Seconds until the confirmation token expires. Default 60, min 5, max 300.
